company.name: Empower Capital ES
company.shortDescription: Pioneering Sustainability through Industrial Green Gases, Biogas, and Green Fertilizers
company.description:
Empower Capital, is a pioneering force in the renewable energy and waste management sector. Since its inception in 2018, the company has been at the forefront of revolutionizing the waste-to-energy industry in Egypt. With a team of highly qualified engineers and employees, Empower Capital is dedicated to providing innovative solutions for the effective management of agricultural and industrial food waste. The company's core focus lies in the generation of biogas, which serves as a sustainable alternative to natural gas, and the production of biofertilizer using cutting-edge biotechnology. By incorporating biostimulants into their biofertilizer, Empower Capital aims to replace traditional mineral fertilizers, furthering their commitment to environmental sustainability. Through their decarbonization solutions, the company is steadfast in its mission to reduce carbon emissions for its clients, adhering to the highest international standards. Empower Capital's unwavering dedication to reshaping the waste management landscape and providing renewable energy options underscores its position as an industry leader in Egypt and beyond.

Empower Capital specializes in waste-to-energy solutions, encompassing the efficient management of agricultural and industrial food waste to generate biogas, biofertilizer, and biostimulants. The company's focus on decarbonization solutions aims to reduce carbon emissions for clients according to the highest international standards, positioning Empower Capital at the forefront of sustainable energy and waste management innovation. Our vision aligns closely with Green Economy
